data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word 'leshech,' meaning 'pine tree,' and the Greek word 'leos,' meaning 'lion.' In Christian tradition, Leisha is a name that symbolizes the strength and grace of God. The name Leisha carries the meaning “God's grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Leisha usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Leisha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
data.cultural_impact: Leisha is a rare name, with roots in both Hebrew and Greek mythologies. In ancient cultures, the pine tree was believed to be a symbol of renewal, perseverance, and growth, while the lion represented power, courage, and protection. For Christians, the name Leisha embodies both the divine yet earthly attributes of God. The cultural impact of this name is one that honors the vast wisdom and endless love of God.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, the name Leisha is a reminder of the many ways in which God protects and nurtures us. The pine tree symbolizes God's eternal and unconditional love, while the lion represents His strength and might. Leisha can be a source of inspiration and comfort, encouraging us to lean on God during difficult times and to find strength and grace in His presence. Ultimately, this beautiful and unique name is a reflection of the amazing complexity of the divine being we call God.
